justification: The only correspondence is the most generic one: each surface carries a profile figure carved in shallow relief occupying most of the field. A depicts a densely detailed composite human-headed winged figure with patterned feathers, braided hair and a flowering plant/rosette staff, whereas B shows a single bare, minimally outlined animal-like form with zigzag limbs and no accompanying motifs, ornament or filling detail whatsoever.
